# Qampus

> Campus queueing for CSPC CCIT: students take a ticket, watch their place, and show the code at the counter.

## Public pages

- [Home](/) - Start here: what Qampus does and how to take a ticket.
- [Public display](/display) - Live board of ticket codes, services, counters, and waiting count.
- [Terms of Use](/rules) - Queue rules, one active ticket per service per day, and no-show handling.
- [Privacy Policy](/privacy) - What is stored, what the public display hides, and how long data is kept.

## Private areas

- /queue, /staff, /admin, /profile, /login, /register
- These require an account and are not for indexing.

## Notes

- Timezone: Asia/Manila. Timestamps are stored in UTC and shown in local time.
- The public display contains no names, emails, or student numbers.
- Demo accounts exist only for the local demo and are not real people.
